# LinkedFiles

> LinkedFiles is an early-access Windows desktop app that shows which Blender projects reference a file you select.

LinkedFiles is for Blender artists, 3D modelers, freelancers, and studios who have textures, models, HDRIs, materials, or other files and need to know which .blend projects use them.

## What it does

- You select one asset, then a folder of Blender projects.
- LinkedFiles reads saved .blend files, including nested folders, and builds a search index on your computer.
- Results are grouped by project and can include the object, material, and node path.
- Blender does not need to be running. Save projects first so the latest links are included.
- Supported external files include common images such as PNG, JPG, EXR, HDR, TGA, and WEBP, plus other files linked from Blender.

## What it does not do

- It does not upload your projects or asset library in normal use.
- Public documentation describes reading .blend files and storing a local index. It does not describe editing or rewriting projects.
- It does not rewrite paths when you move or rename a file.
- It searches one selected file at a time. It does not produce a library-wide list of every unused file.
- A search with no results is not proof a file is safe to delete. The file may be packed inside a .blend, sitting in an unsaved project, or used outside Blender.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or later, 64-bit
- Early access. Features and performance may change.
- Download: https://github.com/Rainfall831/LinkedFiles-releases/releases/latest
